design.enablement: existing getenv presence only; absent off, present empty/0 on
design.clock: existing std::chrono::steady_clock Clock/ms_since in same source
design.mark_host_ms: enabled successful mark body: event creation if needed, vector/phase bookkeeping, existing record/require, used increment
design.fold_host_ms: enabled successful fold body: all existing elapsed query/require/phase accumulation and retained-marker bookkeeping; enabled no-op folds included
design.new_events: successful event_create calls only for newly needed Event objects
design.fold_calls: every enabled fold entry, including used<2
design.completed_intervals: increments only after actual event_elapsed_ms passes existing production require
design.endpoint_counts: no endpoint/UR/driver counter; interval count is not endpoint getter count
design.output: one line after unchanged existing completed phase/host lines; host wall CPU API overhead explicitly not GPU service/calibration
design.failure: existing require propagates; failed inner/final elapsed query skips both existing completed phase reports and new summary; no partial output in destructor/catch

limitations: Source-only: all serial application/build/lint/test/GPU qualification belongs to Main.
Host wall is not CPU cycles/thread CPU service; includes API blocking, descheduling, allocation and local bookkeeping.
Clock/counter instrumentation can perturb timing-on queue timeline and is not fully self-measured or calibrated.
No disjoint-share, exclusive GPU/DMA service, phase additivity, timer-domain accuracy or performance winner claim.
No actual new overhead magnitude/count measurement; historical32K receipt unchanged and not retrofitted.
No endpoint count inferred as actual backend driver calls; failed query paths may stop between getters.
No GPU fault/query-failure injection, smaller hardware/NVIDIA or model quality/MTP/cache/context qualification.
Existing later optional GDN hash can still fail after phase report; Main must retain final run/process status.
No observer/parser edits; consumers rejecting unknown stderr must allow this optional distinct diagnostic prefix.
